string.text: Well... oh! I don't even know if you've ever held a piece like this... An upgraded Kalash! An AK-105, to be exact: a 45-round mag and a rail for foreign scopes! I traded a Duty guy some medkits for it, I remember. Back then Freedom had wrecked their squad so bad the Duty guys were running low on supplies... Later this gun saved my life three times... Yeah, this one's definitely mine!
Here, the FNX-45 pistol! A great gun. Yeah, you still owe me 2800.
Here, the FNX-45! You owe me 2800 more.
Look, this is a Desert Eagle, with a red dot sight and a compensator. A killer piece! The remaining 2800 and it's yours.
Here's a Desert Eagle, with a red dot and a compensator. A killer pistol! Heavy, though... The remaining 2800 and it's yours.
A SIG Sauer P320 pistol chambered in .45 ACP. Made in a small batch on order from some unknown special unit. The remaining 2800 and it's yours.
Here, the SIG P320 .45 ACP pistol. You owe me 2800 more.
One second! There, the RPD! You owe me 28000 more.
Here: the RPD machine gun. You owe me 28000 more.
Here: the Barrett M98 Bravo! Look how big she is... Well, 28000 and she's yours.
Sure. Here: the Barrett M98 Bravo, a powerful thing... The missing 28000 and she's yours.
I believe this is exactly what you need. The PKP "Pecheneg"! 28000 and it's yours.
Sure. The PKP "Pecheneg". For 28000.
Here, an M4, tactical version. For 16000 this beauty is yours.
Here, the M4. You owe me 16000.
Here, the Groza 5.45. For 16000 this beauty is yours.
Here, a Groza chambered in 5.45. You owe me 16000.
Here: the VSS Vintorez, with a tactical grip and a cheek rest on the stock for easier aiming. 16000 more.
Sure. Here: the VSS Vintorez, tactical. For the missing 16000.
Here: the SV-98! Well, 32000 and she's yours.
Sure. Here: the SV-98... The missing 32000 and she's yours.
Here, the L96A1, also known as the AWP. Don't ask where I got it... You owe me 32000 more.
Uh-huh. The L96A1 sniper rifle. You owe me 32000 more.
Take it: an M24, brought in from far away! You owe me the remaining 32000.
Look what I managed to get! An M24! You owe me the remaining 32000.
Heavy weapons.
No problem. It'll cost you 30000, and I'll need 2000 of it up front.
You turned down the previous order... So this one will cost you 26000, and I'll need 4000 up front.
Tactical weapons.
Tactical? Well, I've got something in mind... The usual price is 20000, 4000 of it as a deposit. How about it?
I can get it for 36000, but you'll need to pay 4000 of it in advance.
